correctness.rationale: For the exact smooth plane quartic y^3z=x(x^3-z^3) over C and its entire automorphism group C9 generated by (x,y,z)->(zeta3 x,zeta9 y,z), Liang Theorem 4.3 gives the fixed hyperflex z=0, all 27 other bitangents ax+by+z=0, and a^9-96a^6+48a^3+64=0 with action (a,b)->(zeta3 a,zeta9 b). The order-three subgroup g^3 fixes only the line y=0 and lines ax+cz=0; restriction to C shows either four distinct intersections or multiplicities (3,1), including the x=0 limiting case, so only z=0 is invariant as a bitangent. Each nonhyperflex orbit has length nine; u=a^3 is invariant and satisfies a separable irreducible cubic u^3-96u^2+48u+64=0, so precisely three nine-element fibers. Exact reductions verify u=-36t^2-12t+104 and t= -u^2/48+2u-2/3 where t^3-3t+1=0, the real Q(zeta9+zeta9^-1) cubic. Basis dx/y^2, x dx/y^2, dx/y has g-eigenvalues zeta9^(1,4,2); conjugates fill six primitive 9th roots, hence char(H1)=Phi9=T^6+T^3+1. Reduction mod2 irreducible because ord_9(2)=6, and gcd(Phi9,T^k-1)=1 for 1<=k<=8, giving seven free nine-orbits on 63 nonzero Jac[2]. Fixed odd theta via hyperflex and parity preserve 28 odd=1+3*9, 36 even=4*9; general correspondences yield Cayley octads and Steiner complexes. Independent exact polynomial reductions/finite-field irreducibility replicated the nonstandard certificate.

Orbit structures on its classical 28 bitangents, 36 even theta/Cayley octads and 63 Steiner complexes are intrinsic geometric invariants of immediate use in equivariant calculations, and the three free bitangent orbits acquire an exact arithmetic cubic-field labeling. This is an integrated natural classification, not arbitrary slicing of a large finite list.
